title: NeuroSwap
tagline: NeuroSwap is a decentralized liquidity and execution layer engineered for trading.
description: NeuroSwap is a decentralized liquidity and execution layer engineered for high-frequency, cross-chain asset exchange. Built on a modular smart contract architecture, it leverages advanced routing algorithms, MEV-resistant order matching, and on-chain risk management to deliver sub-second swaps with deterministic finality.
how_its_made:
Tech used
Frontend
- React
- Shadcn
- Tailwind

Back End
- Zircuit (Primary deployment)
- Hedera (AI + smart contracts)
- Base (Scaling)
- Arbitrum (Scaling)
- LayerZero V2 - Omnichain messaging and orchestration
- Chainlink CCIP - Cross-chain messaging and Cross-Chain Token (CCT) standard
- Flare Network - FTSO price feeds and FDC data validation
- Chainlink - Market data and price feeds
- ASI Alliance - AI agent infrastructure and tools

Core DeFi Technologies
- AMM (Automated Market Maker) - Core DEX functionality
- ERC-20 tokens - Standard token interface
- Smart contracts - Solidity-based core logic
- Cryptographic signatures - Parameter validation

Development stack
- Hardhat 3.0 - Smart contract development framework
- pnpm - Package management
- Solidity - Smart contract programming language
